items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I got Dick Vance, and we had a little drummer named Kenny... I did some records with Dick Vance and Benny Morton on my own

ctx.x: No, he wasn't there long. But I think it was about '43. I think. But anyway, I started going there and then my friend Dick Vance, he started to go there the same time that I did, the year after I went. But while I was studying in Juilliard I was studying the Schillinger (PHONETIC) system and I was pretty well along with it. So my teacher at Juilliard was studying the Schillinger System from me on Saturday. And the funny thing about it, from my experience everytime he got up in class and gave a theory he would…

But anyway, I was majoring in composition in Juilliard and it worked out pretty good. I went there about two years. Then I stopped because it wasn't nothing -- but I did graduate from Rhodes High School. And I opened my own studio right on 48th Street over Manny's and started teaching. Well, my teacher, Tom Timothy, was sending me his overflow from his class.
